pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark-pigmented regions with sharp pixel-level transitions at the boundaries. Shapes are predominantly four-to-six sided with varying spatial areas, appearing larger on the upper flank and decreasing in size toward the lower neck and shoulder regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radiate or quadri-radiate. The pathways maintain a relatively uniform pixel thickness across the visible mid-section of the animal.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck exhibits a fine-textured, serrated silhouette against the background with a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A tail with a prominent dark-haired terminal tuft is positioned diagonally across the right posterior quadrant of the frame, partially occluding the flank pelage pattern.
